messages.subject: mzAlign causing crashes
messages.body_plain:
I have been attempting to calibrate some of my images to reference peaks using the mzAlign function. I thought at first this might be an issue with memory, so I tried it on small groups and single pixels. It worked for most pixels, but would consistently crash on others. There is no error message to go off of, as R crashes completely.

I'm not sure if this is happening because those peaks aren't found in those pixels or what. If anyone knows what is causing this or how to work around this, it would be much appreciated. Thanks,

Andrew

messages.subject: Re: mzAlign causing crashes
messages.body_plain:
Hi Kylie,
peakBin() also fails on those same pixels. Some more information on the image: it is from a low (20k) resolution MALDI-ToF (mass accuracy is not fantastic when imaging) and I read in an Analyze file for the data variable below. Here is the processing code:

dataProc = data %>%
  normalize() %>%
  smoothSignal() %>%
  reduceBaseline() %>%
  peakPick() %>%
  process()

dataFilt = dataProc %>%
  peakAlign(tolerance = 0.2, units = "mz") %>%
  peakFilter() %>%
  process()

dataBinned = data %>%
  normalize() %>%
  smoothSignal() %>%
  reduceBaseline() %>%
  peakBin(mz(dataFilt), tolerance = 0.2, units = "mz") %>%  # Running this block individually (normalize, then smoothSignal, etc.), this step causes a crash.
  process()

messages.body_plain:

I am encountering some problems while processing image files with Cardinal.
Could you please help me on this issues?

The first one is I got the
Warning message:
In PositionDataFrame(coord = coord, run = metadata(info)[["name"]]) :
  rows of 'coord' + 'run' are not unique

What does it mean and how can I fix it?

The second one is error of subscript out of bounds during processing mean spectrum.
> Liver_mean <- summarizeFeatures(Liver, FUN="mean")
summarizing [mean] by feature ...
processing chunk 1/20
Error: BiocParallel errors
  1 remote errors, element index: 1
  19 unevaluated and other errors
  first remote error:
Error in h(simpleError(msg, call)): error in evaluating the argument 'x' in selecting a method for function 'as.matrix': subscript out of bounds

The third one is R completely crashes after producing two images.
Please refer to the attached image.
